sloka: शत्रुघ्नस्य तु गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितविक्रमाः ।इदं गमनमस्माकं स्वर्गायाख्यातु मा चिरम् ।। ७.१०७.८ ॥
transliteration: śatrughnasya tu gacchantu dūtāstvaritavikramāḥ ।idaṁ gamanamasmākaṁ svargāyākhyātu mā ciram ।। 7.107.8 ॥

translations.english: Let swift messengers go to Shatrughna and without delay inform him of our departure to heaven.
